summary: Seven adversarial cases cover the six attacks of the brief against the S2 oxlint guards, each with a paired control on the real tree. Five attacks hold: the case 1 scanner reports an ESLint-family declaration in each of the five manifest fields, in nested override objects, and under version-suffixed keys (eslint@10, eslint-config-next@16.2.0, @eslint/js@10, @eslint/eslintrc@4, typescript-eslint@8); the case 2 and case 3 walks find a seeded second .oxlintrc.json, a nested .oxlintrc.json, and eslint.config.{mjs,js,cjs} files in a temp tree while a node_modules copy stays invisible; the extracted case 3 rule rejects all eight seeded mutant lint scripts (dropped --config, wrong config target, dropped --max-warnings 0, budget 1, npx prefix, wrong lint path, template echo replaced) and a dropped lint script fails the count and danielson sentinels; a mutant root config whose override globs match no file makes the case 4 probe pass vacuously, so the case 4 guard shape fails on the mutant and cannot false-green, and a probe outside apps/ and packages/ proves the apps/ placement of the probe is load-bearing; the case 9 scan reports a seeded eslint-config-next key, a nested typescript-eslint key, a non-peer root eslint copy, a non-peer nested @eslint/js copy, and a missing jsPlugins key, while the same lockfile with peer: true everywhere reports nothing. The sixth attack found a real defect, committed as the failing guard adv 7: no S2 case scans workspace sources for disable comments, the strategy section 8 defense for 'Zero warnings by blanket disable' (case 7) never landed in the plan, and 43 of the 49 tracked files that hold an eslint-disable or oxlint-disable directive hide live oxlint findings under the root config, including blanket blocks such as apps/integrated-math-2/components/student/TriangleOrderingPractice.tsx:1 hiding next(no-img-element). This disproves the plan S2 Implement claim 'No finding: every oxlint log has empty output with exit 0, so no behavior-preserving fix was needed' (plan.md:309). Filter run: 6 passed, 1 failed (adv 7, intended). The S2 oxlint, S1 adversarial, and S1 vinext filters still pass in full. Full scripts suite: 54 passed, 2 failed (adv 7 plus the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints baseline row). PROJECT_TESTS gate (GATES_RESUME=1 GATES_BASE=baseline-m2 gates.sh test s2, fresh re-run of exactly the scripts-suite job whose inputs changed) prints NEWFAIL=1 exit 1 with the single new diagnostic adv 7. No manifest, lockfile, config, or production file changed: 6e754bd6..b6344565 holds the one test file only. No 'not applicable' mark was used on any attack.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the S2 guard set has no source-file disable-comment scan, and 43 tracked files under apps/ and packages/ hide live oxlint findings behind eslint-disable and oxlint-disable comments, so the S2 zero-warnings state is maintained partly by legacy suppressions, not by clean code. Strategy section 8 names the defense for the risk 'Zero warnings by blanket disable': case 7, no blanket oxlint-disable in sources and a reason on each disable-next-line (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/test-strategy.md:539). The plan S2 Test (Red) task holds cases 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, and 9b only (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/plan.md:286-297), so the defense is unimplemented; the proposed case 7 would itself be vacuous because the tree uses the eslint-disable spellings. Facts: 49 files hold a directive (7 blanket blocks, 53 eslint-disable-next-line, 3 oxlint-disable-next-line, 1 eslint-disable-line; 44 of 56 next-line directives lack a -- reason); 43 hide live findings, for example apps/integrated-math-2/components/student/TriangleOrderingPractice.tsx:1 hiding next(no-img-element) at 125:8, four lib/convex/server.ts copies hiding typescript(no-explicit-any) errors, and apps/pre-calculus/app/student/dashboard/page.tsx hiding next(no-html-link-for-pages) and react-hooks-js(purity). This disproves the claim 'No finding: every oxlint log has empty output with exit 0, so no behavior-preserving fix was needed' (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/plan.md:309) while the paired control holds: all 27 workspace lint scripts exit 0 (gates/s2/lint.exit). The committed failing guard is 'S2 adversarial > adv 7: no disable comment in the linted surface hides a live oxlint finding' (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1210). Green must resolve F1: fix the 43 files, or convert adv 7 into a PM-approved allow-list guard with the debt recorded, or move the 43 files to a remediation track (question Q1, default: allow-list plus tech-debt entry).
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: strategy section 8, risk 'Oxlint reads no file', cites the defense 'Each lint log has a labeled count on <n> files. Parse <n>. It is above 0' (measure/tracks/vinext-oxc-toolchain_20261114/test-strategy.md:540). No S2 case parses a file count, and oxlint 1.93.0 prints no per-run file count: a clean run prints nothing at all (verified with npx oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --max-warnings 0 on a clean file), so the defense as written cannot exist. The actual defenses are the case 4 probe and the exact-form lint scripts. Default disposition: no change; mark the row superseded by case 4 at the next strategy revision.
